title: joy uploaded
style: Suno Style: structured vocal-only phonk funk track meets sly electro-house, vinyl crackle intro, seductive female lead into catchy EN/PT hook, phonk-funk bounce verse 1 with fast male rap + melodic female, warm Portuguese pre-chorus, high-energy duet pre-chorus, massive layered group chorus with tight vocal stacking, chant post-chorus, double-time rapid-fire verse 2, gritty spoken bridge, emotional airy high singer hold, arena redline final chorus, huge crowd chant final hook, soft vinyl outro, multilingual joyful energy EN/PT/ES, punk-rock snarl mid vocals, call-and-response hooks, warm bass feel through voices only, high club rave energy, pure human voice power, no instruments
lyrics:
[INTRO — sly electro-house vinyl crackle]
[Fem Lead – soft & seductive]
Meet me in the signal, meet me in the sound
If you got something real, don’t type it — lay it down
[HOOK — EN/PT blend]
Joy upload, 100 percent
From my chest straight to your content
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando
No more pain in the feed, só quando eu ando
[VERSE 1 — phonk-funk bounce]
[Male Rap]
I don’t want your keyboard flex, no paragraphs, no cap
Everybody tough behind the screen till the voice says “what you got?”
I slid in through the waveform, low lights, bass attack
You dropped two real words and I felt that
Scroll full of storms, so I built a sun
Every beat a little place to run
If it moves your chest, it qualifies
Not the chart, but the human eyes
[Female – melodic]
No comment section, no reply chain, no dopamine war
This ain’t a feed, this a frequency — open up the door
[PRE-CHORUS — warm PT]
Alegria não é acidente
É frequência que escolhe a gente
Se tua alma sente o som
Já ganhou sem competição
[CHORUS — massive layered drop]
[All]
Joy Upload! I sing it back!
Joy Upload! We own the track!
We flip the whole world up and never let it stop
Joy upload, 100 percent
From my chest straight to your content
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando
We race on love, not on how bad it’s gone
[POST-CHORUS — chant]
[All]
In the song! In the song!
Ponlo en la canción!
Joy Upload! Joy Upload!
No comments! Just real ones!
[VERSE 2 — double-time]
[Mid – rapid-fire]
Four Coreys in the room, whole world watching me
Reporters flashing nonstop, questions stacking like a spree
Teacher lost in fog? Nah — I decode it live on stage
C+ Corey and me, we flip the script, we turn the page!
[Male Rap]
I need the crack in your voice, not the perfect written line
That little break, that human shake — tell me it’s real this time
We don’t farm pain, we farm the coming years
If your heart’s loud, turn it to sound right here
[Female]
Muévelo, déjalo arder
Si vas a hablar, hazlo en la canción, no en el chat, player
[BRIDGE — spoken grit]
[Male Spoken]
You want it clear? Here it is.
Don’t type to me. Sing to me.
Joy upload, from your chest to the sky
[High Singer – emotional hold]
We are the real Coreys… the ones who sing awake…
[FINAL CHORUS — arena redline]
[All]
Joy Upload! I sing it back!
Joy Upload! We own the track!
No comments for the empty crowd, only songs that make us brave
Joy upload, 100 percent
Night-ride glow on every continent
Alegria em cada beat que eu mando
If you mean it — put that feeling in the song!
[FINAL HOOK]
[All]
In the song! In the song!
Ponlo en la canción!
Joy Upload! (x4, climbing)
Joy Upload!
[OUTRO — soft vinyl fade]
[Fem Lead]
Meet me in the signal… meet me in the sound…
Solo canciones… alegria em cada som…
